title: The research capability probe is live and costs no search credit
statement: On the PM's Windows host on 2026-08-22, `research_capability` returned available:true after a live GET /usage against api.tavily.com, reporting 1500 of 1500 credits remaining and 0 used. The zero-used figure is what shows the probe did not perform a search.
notes: ⚠️ Scoped to what was actually observed, per the AST-0003 and AST-0007 lesson. It says the probe WORKED ON THAT HOST ON THAT DAY. It does not claim the probe works when the key is absent or rejected — those paths are covered by constructed fixtures in test/research.test.mjs, not by this run — and it does not claim anything about search, which has still never been called live. ⚠️ THIS ASSERTION HAS NO EVIDENCE, and the reason is not that none exists. The run happened and its output is known; the typed path REFUSED the evidence record because an experiment must carry an environment and an environment must name a sandbox tier, and this ran under none (QST-0012). It therefore sits at rung 1 — unverified — while the observation that would settle it is sitting in a terminal. That state is left visible on purpose: filling it in with a tier that did not apply would convert a recording defect into a false confidence rung, which is the exact failure #42's ladder exists to prevent.
